title: East Uusimaa: 0.3 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €15,600 a year
markdown:
# East Uusimaa: 0.3 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €15,600 a year

> 0.3 more patients a year treated to cure · €15,600 of €1M · €984,400 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in East Uusimaa, 28 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties (30.4%), about 1.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure, with a range of 0.0–4.0. [^care_curative] [^model] Compared with Finland as a whole, there is no measured shortfall to split between surgery and radiotherapy (range up to 2.2 a year). [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 28.3% to 28.8% by 2028: 0.3 more patients a year (range 0.0–0.6), for €15,600 a year, about €57,778 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €15,600 | 0.3 (0.0–0.6) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 28.3% → 28.8% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€15,600** | **0.3 (0.0–0.6)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €318,752 a year; modelled to avoid 0.5 deaths a year (0.1–1.4). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 28.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 28.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €984,400 buys nothing more in the model. The access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 48 deaths a year in East Uusimaa, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.0 of them (0.0–0.2). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 27 new patients and 24 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 0 of them (0 to 0) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 28.3% to 28.3% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- The effects are assumptions, not trial results. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest. It is not a probability range. [^model]
- The expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, other illness, histology, how the cancer was found or smoking. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- Checked against measured outcomes, the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock matched 0 of 3 in the expected direction beyond chance. [^model]
